about.title: Malibu Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Malibu is a small community, about 12,965 residents, stretched along Pacific Coast Highway, and a death here is felt widely. In 2025, public records show 75 injury collisions on Malibu roads, 115 people hurt, and one life lost. Behind that single number is a family now facing decisions no one prepares for. California law gives certain relatives a way to hold a negligent driver, property owner, or business accountable through a civil wrongful death claim. That claim stands apart from any criminal case the district attorney may or may not bring. A spouse or domestic partner and children generally have the first right to file, followed by specific dependents or heirs. Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. The deadline is usually two years from the date of death, and shorter when a public agency is involved. LawProactive connects Malibu families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, at no charge for the connection.

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can explain where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines Handled Early
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and the window closes sooner when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting connected promptly protects that timeline.

items.title: No Fee Unless There Is a Recovery
items.desc: Our connection service is free, and network attorneys work on contingency. Your family does not pay attorney fees out of pocket while grieving.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on Pacific Coast Highway in Malibu. Who is allowed to bring a claim?
items.answer: California places the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children at the front of the line. If none exist, certain dependents or heirs may qualify. An attorney can review your specific family situation, since the rules can get detailed when there are stepchildren, parents, or a partner who relied on the deceased financially.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves separately from any criminal prosecution. The criminal case may produce useful evidence, but the two-year civil deadline keeps running regardless of what happens in criminal court, so it is wise to speak with an attorney early.

items.question: What can a Malibu family actually recover in a wrongful death case?
items.answer: California allows recovery of funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have contributed, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Every family's losses look different, and no one can promise a particular result. An independent attorney will help you document what was truly lost.
